[All reconstruction reports](index.md) · [Material and EOS parameters](../material-summaries/argon_fcc.md) · [EOSMAT record file](https://github.com/CPrescher/peritheos/blob/main/peritheos/data/materials/argon_fcc.eosmat) · [Audit sidecar](https://github.com/CPrescher/peritheos/blob/main/peritheos/data/audits/argon_fcc.audit.json)

Each section opens with the record's reproduction headline and any usage
warning ([label definitions](../eos-labels.md)), then the scope and basis of
the stored check. Only recorded content is shown: missing selections, weights,
errors or conventions are unknown, not zero, and are not inferred. Generating
this page fits nothing and changes no classification or source coefficient.
Every record is also listed by identifier in the
[numerical ledger](../primary-eos-refits.md#records), its
[machine-readable form](https://github.com/CPrescher/peritheos/blob/main/docs/data/primary-eos-refits.json) and the
[source-audit reports](../source-audits.md).

**Curves and residuals** replay the full stored source and reconstructed
coefficients on the same recorded audit inputs. Residual = model − input in
the fitted quantity's native units; for pressure, P(model) − P(input) at each
input volume and temperature (isothermal records use their reference
temperature). RMS is an unweighted descriptive error, not a parameter
uncertainty or the weighted fitting objective. With more than five
temperatures, the minimum, middle and maximum isotherms are drawn; residuals
include every selected row. Error bars appear only where all widths are
recoverable and keep the source meaning, including digitization widths.
No uncertainty band is inferred.

**Coefficient graphs** show stored central values and recorded error widths
in the audit's units; each panel includes zero. They are not observation or
residual plots. Fixed/adopted values are constraints, not recovered values.
Tables round an error to two significant digits when its leading digit is 1
or 2, otherwise one, and the value to the error's decimal place; values
without a positive error show at most six significant digits. Full precision
stays in EOSMAT and the ledger.

## Dewaele et al. (2021), quasi-hydrostatic Vinet-MGD

**close** · `argon_fcc_dewaele_2021_vinet_mgd` · `Vinet` · [Coefficients and source](../material-summaries/argon_fcc.md#record-argon_fcc_dewaele_2021_vinet_mgd)

**Scope:** Comparison with the source parameterization. **Basis:** Every compared free coefficient meets either the recorded combined-two-sigma comparison or parameter-specific numerical similarity screen; the audit does not classify the complete comparison as parity.

- 95 selected rows; run 5 is independent validation. Equal-pressure weights are a diagnostic assumption: the publication supplies no objective, weights, coordinate uncertainties or covariance. Both 296 K (Methods) and 300 K (fit prose) evaluated. Missing pressures and duplicate rows retained in bundle.

### Method

- **Dataset identifiers:** argon\_fcc\_dewaele\_2021\_supplement
- **Observations:** 95
- **Fit kind:** primary\_table\_diagnostic
- **Selection:** Runs 2-3 with measured pressure, plus runs 1 and 4 at P&lt;=5 GPa
- **Objective:** equal pressure residuals
- **Free parameters:** V0; K0\_prime
- **Fixed parameters:** K0; Tr; theta0; gamma0; gamma\_inf; beta; anharmonic\_a; anharmonic\_m; electronic\_e; electronic\_g; n

<a id="record-argon_fcc_xiao_2025_helmholtz"></a>

## Xiao et al. (2025), Debye-anharmonic Helmholtz

**untested** (not refittable) · `argon_fcc_xiao_2025_helmholtz` · `NaturalStrain4` · [Coefficients and source](../material-summaries/argon_fcc.md#record-argon_fcc_xiao_2025_helmholtz)

**Scope:** Comparison with the source parameterization. **Basis:** Published parameterization matches the official workbook; the complete global fit remains unreproduced. With equal weights on relative residuals, the best converged nine-parameter 22-volume refit lowers volume RMS from 0.0952% to 0.0322%, but gives a much too low bulk modulus and poorly constrained, bound-dependent parameters. The best converged 27-entry refit gives 0.0603% volume RMS and 0.0818% bulk-modulus RMS, but Cv = -13.88 J/mol/K at 77 K is physically unacceptable. Neither diagnostic replaces the published coefficients. Table 2 weights are published; complete legacy rows and quantitative penalties remain unavailable. Next: recover the remaining multiproperty inputs, then refit with physical constraints and assess parameter stability. \[Detailed comparison and scope\](literature-reproductions/argon-xiao-2025.md#review-conclusion-2026-09-27).

### Method

- **Dataset identifiers:** argon\_fcc\_xiao\_2025\_table5
- **Observations:** 22
- **Fixed parameters:** V0; Tr

### More evidence

- [Supporting source report: argon-xiao-2025](../literature-reproductions/argon-xiao-2025.md#review-conclusion-2026-09-27).
